features.description: Volumetric soil moisture (%). Primary predictor for irrigation need.
features.name: soil_moisture_percent

features.description: Ambient air temperature (°C). Drives evapotranspiration rate.
features.name: air_temperature_celsius

features.description: Relative humidity (%). Component of VPD calculation.
features.name: air_humidity_percent

features.description: Light intensity (lux). Affects stomatal opening and transpiration.
features.name: light_intensity_lux

features.description: Water tank fill level (%). Safety constraint — no irrigation if tank is low.
features.name: water_tank_level_percent

features.description: Integer-encoded rice growth stage (0–7). Determines water requirement window.
features.name: growth_stage_encoded

features.description: Days elapsed since planting date. Refines growth stage within a stage window.
features.name: days_after_transplanting

features.description: Days remaining until harvest. Negative values indicate overdue harvest.
features.name: days_to_maturity

features.description: Vapor Pressure Deficit (kPa). Quantifies plant water stress from heat and dryness.
features.name: vpd_kpa

features.description: Hour when reading was taken (0–23). Captures diurnal irrigation patterns.
features.name: hour_of_day

features.description: Day of week (0=Monday, 6=Sunday). Low importance; included for completeness.
features.name: day_of_week

features.description: Month of year (1–12). Captures seasonal variation in water demand.
features.name: month

features.description: Days elapsed since the last irrigation event. Prevents over-irrigation.
features.name: days_since_last_irrigation
